user.title: Add IR receiver to a Broadlink device
user.description: Pick one of your existing Broadlink devices to expose its IR learning mode as a native infrared receiver entity.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check that it's powered on and reachable on the network.
error.unknown_device: Selected device could not be found.
error.missing_device_info: Could not read host/MAC/type from the selected device's configuration.
error.unsupported_device: The selected device does not support IR learning or has invalid device information.

abort.no_broadlink_devices: No Broadlink devices are configured yet. Set up the core Broadlink integration first, then add an IR receiver for it here.
abort.all_devices_configured: All of your configured Broadlink devices already have an IR receiver entity.
abort.already_configured: This device already has an IR receiver entity.
abort.unsupported_library: Home Assistant 2026.10 or later with Core's async python-broadlink library is required. Remove the conflicting broadlink package and restore Core's requirements, then restart Home Assistant.
